cards.d:
Chinese measure approx. 'foot'.
*As a primitive, this will mean the shakuhachi flute
cards.e: 越尺 월척 big fish (over one cheok); 尺度 척도 a measure, a scale, a criterion

cards.d: This old Japanese man totally exhausted himself giving a winter-time performance of shakuhachi. That winter was so cold, the shakuhachi was getting clogged with ice as the man was playing.
cards.e: 賣盡 매진 sold out; 消盡 소진 exhaustion, vanishing completely

cards.d: This character pictures food whose taste is so hot and spicy that it makes the hairs on your body stand up as straight as needles.
cards.e: 辛辣 신랄 sharp, bitter, severe, harsh; 艱辛히 간신히 barely, hardly, labouriously

cards.d: The eyes of James Bond spy on the happinness of the criminals and enemies just to put an end to their luck and bliss.

You're hiding from the enemy underwater in a swamp. To breathe, you have your shakuhachi flute poking up through the surface of the water.
A spy does not hesitate to hide in water, even in a swamp to be able to spy on.
cards.e: 惠澤 혜택 benefit, boon, favor, grace; 德澤 덕택 indebtness, favor, grace, help; 潤澤 윤택 gloss, luster

cards.d:
You cannot pretend to translate into words the melody of the shakuhachi!
A perfect spy like James Bond does not need a translator, he speaks all languages.

The fingers on the Shakuhachi 'choose' the notes.
The fingers of the spy scan over the walls to find the secret niches where the important documents are hidden.

Roosters in Japan are very civilised, they play the shakuhachi at nightbreak to signify the beginning of daytime.
It is best to take a brush to study at the nightbreak to profit of the daylight to the maximum.
If you are too poor to afford a door, you can just hang a flag instead (noren).
cards.e: 戶 호 house, household; 門戶 문호 door; 富戶 부호 a rich man

cards.d: The shoulder is the best part of the body to bash a door open with (Don't ever try this. Use your foot).
cards.e: 肩章 견장 shoulder strap, epaulet

cards.d: A huge building with many doors and many rooms, a true maze. No compass will help to get out, but a tassel can help to catch a wind and find a direction out.
cards.e: 노래房 노래방 karaoke room; 廚房 주방 kitchen; 冷房 냉방 cold room, air conditioning

cards.d: A door panel flaps and produces a stream of air not worse than a large fan of feathers.

- Honey? Do we have any wood left for the hearth?
- Aagh, just use the frickin' door!
cards.e: 暖爐 (煖爐) 난로 stove, heater, fireplace; 火爐 화로 brazier, fire pot/box

cards.d: The St. Bernard dog whining at the door of his master’s house in order to re-enter / re-turn inside, but the perverse master enjoys the dog's pain.
cards.e: 拂戾 불려- refund; 返戾하다 반려하다 to return/reject a document without approval

cards.d: The story of Hachiko: the faithfull dog who still waited for his master to return long after he had died. Brings a tear to the eye.
Our company has no standards. We'll employ any turkey who walks in the door.
cards.e: 雇用 고용 employment; 雇傭 고용 employment, engagement

cards.d: The people we employ are always turning their heads to look back. They don't want to be caught playing solitare on company time.
cards.e: 顧客 고객 customer, client; 回顧 회고 recollection, restrospection

cards.d: It's best not to disclose what you were forced to do with your mouth behind closed doors for your taskmaster.
cards.e: 啓發 계발 enlightment, illumination, edification, education, development; 啓示 계시 revelation (religious)
